pNone_chapter_1: In a sun-drenched colonial-style living room, Byomkesh Bakshi reclines in a wooden easy chair, an open book resting in his lap. He wears a crisp white dhoti-kurta and looks up with a skeptical expression at Satyabati, who stands beside him in a traditional patterned sari holding a glass of vibrant red juice. Ajit sits nearby on a wooden stool, observing the interaction with a faint, knowing smile. Warm afternoon light filters through large slatted windows, illuminating the dust motes and the stacks of books surrounding the trio.
